Package com.stockly.controller

Interface AppShell

All Known Implementing Classes:
MainController
public interface AppShell
The services the main window offers to the page controllers (dashboard, inventory, reports).

Page controllers depend only on this small interface, not on MainController, which keeps them independent of each other and easy to reason about.

Author:
Umama Wahab
